scenario.title: Meeting Room Reservation
scenario.initial_description: A meeting room is reserved for a team meeting. The organizer checks availability and shares the room information with participants.

reference_workflow.goal: Reserve an appropriate meeting room and notify participants with room details.

activities.name: Collect meeting time and participant count
Select room matching capacity and equipment needs

decisions.condition: Does the meeting require special equipment?

automation_opportunities.rationale: Availability checks can be automated through calendar and reservation APIs.
Room selection can be rule-based using capacity, location, and equipment constraints.
Calendar invitation updates can be automated after reservation.

activities.name: Is a suitable room available?
activities.condition: A suitable room matching the requirements is available for the desired time slot
branches: No - adjust requirements or time slot

activities.name: Adjust Meeting Requirements or Time Slot
outputs: Revised meeting requirements or revised time slot

activities.name: Send Room Information to Participants
outputs: Meeting invitation with room details sent to participants

activities.name: Have all key participants confirmed?
activities.condition: Required participants have accepted the meeting invitation

decisions.condition: Is a suitable room available for the desired time slot?
branches: Room not available - return to A3

decisions.condition: Have all key participants confirmed attendance?
branches: Not all confirmed - proceed to A7

exceptions.description: Room becomes unavailable after reservation due to system error or double booking
exceptions.handling: Notify organizer, trigger re-availability check, rebook alternative room

exceptions.description: No suitable room is available within acceptable alternative time slots
exceptions.handling: Escalate to facility manager or consider virtual meeting alternative

exceptions.description: Meeting invitation delivery failure to one or more participants
exceptions.handling: Retry delivery or use alternative communication channel

exceptions.description: Organizer cancels the meeting after reservation
exceptions.handling: Release room reservation, notify all participants of cancellation

automation_opportunities.rationale: Room availability lookup is a structured query against booking data and can be fully automated using a scheduling system API, eliminating manual search effort.
constraints: Room booking system must expose a query API or integration interface
Real-time data synchronization required to avoid stale availability results

automation_opportunities.rationale: Once a room is selected, the booking action is a deterministic transaction that can be automated via API call to the room booking system, reducing manual steps and booking errors.
constraints: Requires organizer authorization and authentication
Booking system must support programmatic reservation

automation_opportunities.target: A5 - Send Room Information to Participants
automation_opportunities.rationale: Sending meeting invitations with room details is a templated communication task easily automated through calendar/email integration once reservation is confirmed.
constraints: Participant contact data must be current and accessible
Calendar system must support automated invite creation and dispatch

automation_opportunities.target: D1 - Is a suitable room available?
automation_opportunities.rationale: The availability decision is rule-based and can be evaluated automatically by the booking system based on predefined criteria such as capacity and facility requirements.
constraints: Decision logic must be codified into the scheduling system rules

automation_opportunities.target: A7 - Follow Up with Non-Responding Participants
automation_opportunities.rationale: Automated reminders for non-responding participants can be triggered based on a time threshold after the initial invite, reducing organizer workload.
constraints: Must avoid excessive reminder frequency to prevent notification fatigue
Should respect participant communication preferences

automation_opportunities.target: D2 - Have all key participants confirmed?
automation_opportunities.rationale: Response tracking is a data aggregation task that can be automated by monitoring calendar invite acceptance statuses and triggering appropriate workflow branches.
required_data: List of mandatory vs optional participants
constraints: Distinction between mandatory and optional participants must be defined by organizer
Calendar system must expose response status via API

automation_opportunities.target: A3 - Adjust Meeting Requirements or Time Slot
automation_opportunities.rationale: Partial automation is possible by suggesting alternative rooms or time slots automatically when the original choice is unavailable, though final decision remains with the organizer.
constraints: Organizer must retain final approval authority
Suggestion algorithm must balance multiple variables including participant availability

assumptions: A centralized room booking system exists and maintains an up-to-date inventory of meeting rooms and their attributes.
The organizer has access to both a calendar/scheduling tool and the room booking system.
Participants have calendar accounts accessible via the same or interoperable email/calendar platform.
Room requirements such as capacity and required equipment are known before the availability check.
The workflow covers a single meeting reservation cycle; recurring meeting patterns are out of scope.
Participant lists are defined prior to sending invitations and do not change after the booking is made.
A distinction between mandatory and optional participants is assumed for the confirmation decision, defaulting to all invited if not specified.
The process ends once the meeting is confirmed and participants have been notified; post-meeting activities are out of scope.
Virtual meeting alternatives are considered only as an exception fallback when no physical room is available.
System integrations between the room booking system and calendar/email tools are technically feasible in this environment.
